summary: Pit-machine state-conditioned action: reads the current AI mode state at this[97] (offset 0x184) and, when it is 0 or 4, records and dispatches a state-1 transition by calling StateChangeNotify(this, 1). For any other state it returns the read state unchanged without triggering a transition. Called by ForcePitExit (0x0042A110) on the frame path (pit subsystem); a structural twin of SessionTransitionDispatch (004a5e10), differing in that this body only maps states 0 and 4 to state 1.

operations.description: Read the current AI mode state from this[97] (offset 0x184) and branch on its value.
If the state is 0, take the transition path instead of returning the state unchanged.
If the state is 4, also take the transition path; both 0 and 4 converge on the same handler.
State 0/4 path: call StateChangeNotify(this, 1) to record and dispatch the state-1 transition.
For any other state, return the read state value unchanged with no transition performed.

clean_pseudocode: int state = this[97];                    // AI mode state at offset 0x184
return StateChangeNotify(this, 1);     // request the state-1 transition
unresolved: The full pit-machine state set is not visible in this body; states 0 and 4 both mapping to state 1 is observed but not explained by the packet.
The meaning of the returned state value when no transition is taken is unknown.
StateChangeNotify is recorded as a ring-buffer recorder/dispatcher in the existing analysis; its internal contract is not modeled here.
